meta.name: canvas-design
meta.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据描述生成原创视觉设计图片和PDF文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成原创海报、艺术图或静态视觉设计。
copy.tagline_en: Create original visual art and PDF documents from descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate original posters, artwork, or static visual designs.

howto.what: Claude 会先创建一份设计理念文档（.md），然后基于该理念生成一张视觉设计作品（.png 或 .pdf）。作品强调视觉表达，文字极少，风格精致，像手工打磨的艺术品。
howto.when: 当你要求制作海报、艺术作品、设计图或其他静态视觉内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一张极简风格的海报，主题是“城市呼吸”。
say.note: Claude 会先创建设计理念，再生成海报。

say.text: 创作一幅抽象艺术画，命名为“几何沉默”。
say.note: Claude 会围绕该理念生成视觉作品。

howto.what_en: Claude first creates a design philosophy document (.md), then generates a visual artwork (.png or .pdf) based on that philosophy. The output is highly visual with minimal text, crafted to look like a meticulous, museum-quality piece.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static visual content.

say_en.text: Design a minimalist poster with the theme 'Urban Breath'.
say_en.note: Claude will create a philosophy first, then the poster.

say_en.text: Create an abstract art piece named 'Geometric Silence'.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a visual work based on that concept.
